evidence.claim: Stefano Serafini: intraday futures portfolio built on time windows; holds under 24 h; was leading WCC 2017 at recording (checkable contest)
evidence.quote: Stefano Serafini was leading the 2017 World Cup Championship of Futures Trading when this episode was recorded. His edge is not a single magic strategy. It is a disciplined approach to building intraday strategies around time windows, filtering entries with higher timeframe data, and assembling a portfolio of uncorrelated systems
evidence.source: Better System Trader ep. 112 (show notes), Andrew Swanscott, Aug 6 2017, https://bettersystemtrader.com/112-intraday-trading-with-stefano-serafini/

evidence.claim: Serafini avoids reversal strategies on overnight-gap risk
evidence.number: DAX -10%, mini S&P -6% at Aug 2015 open
evidence.quote: He recalled August 2015, when the DAX opened down 10% and the mini S&P opened down 6% due to Chinese growth data.

evidence.claim: Gary Hart: intraday stock-index futures, 1-15 min bars, volatility filter; system 'Mean Swing' claimed top of Futures Truth rankings (checkable record; Futures Truth tracks HYPOTHETICAL results per R7 E16)
evidence.quote: One of Gary’s most successful systems, Mean Swing, has held a top position on the Futures Truth rankings for years, with live trading results closely matching the backtest performance.
evidence.grade: pointer (cited record graded by R7 as hypothetical)

evidence.claim: Hart: intraday edge decayed after QE; needs volatility to clear commission and slippage
evidence.quote: day trading has gotten harder every year, particularly after quantitative easing started suppressing intraday volatility around 2011 and 2012. Low volatility environments are particularly brutal for intraday strategies because you need price movement to generate returns large enough to overcome commission and slippage.

evidence.claim: Hart: systems idle in low vol
evidence.number: up to 3 months with no trades
evidence.quote: Some of his systems can go three months with no trades during low-volatility periods, then trade almost every day when conditions return.

evidence.claim: Andrea Unger (WCC multiple winner) finds no reliable intraday trend-following setups on the S&P E-mini
evidence.quote: For intraday trend-following entries on the S&P E-mini, Andrea says he hasn’t been able to find reliable setup patterns. The market’s natural mean-reversion tendency works against it.

evidence.claim: Unger: S&P mean-reverting, DAX trend-following intraday
evidence.quote: The S&P 500 tends toward mean reversion. The DAX future is more trend-following.
